append.text: **Ps 70:1 = 30:2a copied** (*para sempre não serei envergonhado*, decision `confundar` with Ps 30's options). The v1 Latinist asked the wish (*que eu não seja envergonhado para sempre*) and the v1 stylist the 'not for ever' order again — both held for identical Latin, options 3 and 5. 70:13 *Confundántur* → *Sejam envergonhados*; 70:24 *cum confúsi … fúerint* → *quando forem envergonhados*.

**Ps 70:1 *et éripe me* → *e libertai-me*** (no source; beside *líbera me* → *livrai-me*, two Greek verbs); **70:4 *éripe me de manu peccatóris* → *arrancai-me da mão do pecador*** (source named); **70:11 *non est qui erípiat* → *não há quem liberte*** (= 49:22, no object supplied; the v1 stylist asked *o liberte*, held, option).
**Ps 70:3 *in locum munítum* → *um lugar fortificado*** — applied; no reader remarked.
**Ps 70:3b (named in D31) → *o meu esteio*** — the ambiguity reader listed *esteio* as unknown; kept.
**Ps 70:6 *ex útero … de ventre matris meæ* → *desde o seio materno … desde o ventre da minha mãe*** — as this row proposed (21:10–11's pair); no reader remarked.
**Ps 70:6 *In te confirmátus sum* → *Em vós fui firmado*** (ἐπεστηρίχθην, the passive kept; MS1932 *me firmei* option); passed every reader.
Ps 70:7 *et tu adjútor fortis* → *e vós sois um auxílio forte* (no reader remarked this time); 70:12 *in auxílium meum* is auxílium's own noun.
**Ps 70:8 *Repleátur os meum laude* (πληρωθήτω) → *Que a minha boca se encha de louvor*** — not 62:6's *fartar-se* (another Greek verb).
Ps 70:9 *cum defécerit virtus mea* (ἰσχύς, a man's strength) → *quando desfalecer o meu vigor*, as 21:16, 30:11b, 37:11.

**Ps 70:10 *qui custodiébant ánimam meam* (hostile watchers) → *os que guardavam a minha alma*** — the row held; the ambiguity reader heard protectors first (a betrayal). Options *vigiavam* (DRB), *espreitavam* (MS1932's sense).
Ps 70:10 *consílium fecérunt in unum* → *tomaram conselho juntos* (the idiom for deliberating; *fizeram conselho* option; 30:14's *planejaram* is consiliári's).

**Ps 70:11 *persequímini, † et comprehéndite eum* → *persegui-o, † e prendei-o*** — the rule-3 trap this row foresaw, met with D13's enclitic (MS1932 word for word). The ambiguity reader still heard 'I pursued him' as a possible reading; held (Brazilian past is *eu o persegui*; *e prendei-o* follows).
**Ps 70:12 *ne elongéris a me* → *não fiqueis longe de mim*** — as this row proposed; no remark.
Ps 70:13 *detrahéntes ánimæ meæ* → *os que difamam a minha alma* — applied.
**Ps 70:13 *pudóre* (ἐντροπή) → *desonra*** — merged by D15's Greek test (*cobertos de vergonha e de desonra* = 34:26b); 70:24 *revériti* → *desonrados*. *pudor* (today modesty) option.
Ps 70:14 *adíciam super omnem laudem tuam* → *acrescentarei a todo o vosso louvor* (60:7's *a*; *sobre* option).

**Ps 70:16 *introíbo in poténtias Dómini* → *entrarei nas potências do Senhor*; 70:19 *Poténtiam tuam* → *A vossa potência*** — the row (64:7) followed; the ambiguity reader found the plural vague and listed *potências* as unknown. 105:2 *loquétur poténtias Dómini* should copy. Options *poderes* (merges with virtus), *obras poderosas* (MS1932).
**Ps 70:22 *in vasis psalmi* → *com instrumentos de salmo*** (the named place), moved before the verb in v2 (the stylist: two stacked phrases); *salmodia* (stylist) refused, psalmódia's.
Ps 70:20 *convérsus vivificásti me* → *voltando-vos, me vivificastes* — the ambiguity reader listed *vivificastes* as unknown again; *destes a vida* option.
Ps 70:22 *psallam tibi in cíthara* → *a vós entoarei salmos com a cítara* (58:18's order).
Ps 70:23 *quam redemísti* → *que resgatastes*.

append.row: | *In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum*
append.text: **Ps 70:1 applied** (*… para sempre não serei envergonhado: * livrai-me na vossa justiça, e libertai-me*); passed the Latinist twice as a form, though he asked the wish at v1.

**Ps 70 applied:** 70:2 and 70:3a copied; *in locum munítum* → *um lugar fortificado*; 70:3b *Quóniam firmaméntum meum, et refúgium meum es tu* → *Porque vós sois o meu esteio, * e o meu refúgio* (30:4's natural order; D31).

Ps 70:21 *Multiplicásti magnificéntiam tuam* → *Multiplicastes a vossa magnificência*; 70:8 *magnitúdinem tuam* → *a vossa grandeza*, and 70:19 *magnália* → *as grandes coisas* (new row), three words kept apart in one psalm.

terms: | cantátio | canto (*Em vós está sempre o meu canto*) | open | Ps 70:7, only place (grep); ὕμνησις. The plain noun of *cantar*; *cântico* is cánticum's. The copula supplied; DRB and MS1932 paraphrase ('Of thee shall I sing'). |

| litteratúra | as letras (*Porque não conheço as letras*) | open | Ps 70:16, only place; γραμματεία. Keeps the root and both senses (literacy, learning); the Hebrew's 'numbers' not followed; DRB *learning*, MS1932 *a ciência*. *cognóvi* present by D44 (the Latinist asked *conheci* at v1; option). The ambiguity reader heard 'I cannot read / I am unlearned'. |

| sénium | a idade extrema (*E até a velhice e a idade extrema*) | open | Ps 70:18 beside *senécta* → velhice. Draft 1 *a decrepitude* (L&S's 'feebleness of age') was heard as clinical by the stylist and unknown by the ambiguity reader; *os cabelos brancos* (DRB, MS1932) is the Hebrew's image. |

| magnália | as grandes coisas (*as grandes coisas que fizestes*) | open | Ps 70:19; μεγαλεῖα; DRB *great things*. Apart from magnitúdo → grandeza and mirabília → maravilhas. 105:21 *qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto* should copy. *grandes obras* option. |

| *usque in altíssima* | até as alturas | open | Ps 70:19 (ἕως ὑψίστων), neuter plural; the superlative not heard (*até o mais alto* option). Apart from excélsa → alturas (D42) only by Latin; they do not meet in a psalm. *até o Altíssimo* would be heard as God's name. |

| redúcere | trazer (*de novo me trouxestes*) | open | Ps 70:20 *íterum reduxísti me*; draft 1 *reconduzistes* was heard as bureaucratic (the stylist); *de novo* carries the return. Apart from edúcere → tirar (30:5). |

| pronuntiáre | pronunciar | open | Ps 118:13, 118:172 (applied there without a row), 70:17 *pronuntiábo mirabília tua* → *pronunciarei as vossas maravilhas*. Apart from annuntiáre → anunciar (D41), though the Greek at 70:17 is ἀπαγγελῶ, annuntiáre's verb (so D15's test would allow a merge). The Ps 70 stylist found *pronunciar maravilhas* technical and asked *proclamar* — for Gustavo; option in Ps 70. |

| *mala mihi* (quǽrere / inquírere) | *males contra mim* (*os que buscam males contra mim*) | working | 37:13 *procuravam males contra mim*; Ps 70:13 = 70:24 *qui quærunt mala mihi* → *os que buscam males contra mim*. The Ps 70 stylist found *buscar males contra* stiff and asked *os que me buscam males* (refused for 37:13's wording). 40:6 *dixérunt mala mihi* → *disseram mal de mim* and 40:8 are other builds. |

| *in auxílium meum réspice* | *olhai em meu auxílio* | open | Ps 70:12 (πρόσχες). Draft 1 built it as 21:20 (*olhai para …*); Latinist, stylist and the ambiguity reader heard 'look at my help'; the purpose idiom *em meu auxílio* (D40's phrase) taken. |
| *Sed et* | Mas também | open | Ps 70:24 (ἔτι δὲ καί); *E também* option. |
